Let me research Kubernetes v1.34 version-skew policy for kubectl.

Key facts: Kubernetes version skew policy: kubectl is supported within one minor version (older or newer) of kube-apiserver. Specifically for kube-apiserver 1.34, kubectl 1.33, 1.34, 1.35 are permitted? Historically, kubectl supported within one minor version older or newer. But newer versions of docs (since 1.28?) changed to: kubectl is supported within one minor version (older or newer) of kube-apiserver. So kubectl 1.33, 1.34, 1.35 for apiserver 1.34.

However, note in HA upgrade: apiservers at 1.33 and 1.34, intersection is kubectl 1.33, 1.34 (1.35 not supported since it must be within one of 1.33, and 1.35 is two newer than 1.33... wait 1.33+1 = 1.34, so 1.35 is two minor ahead of 1.33, not allowed). So intersection = {1.33, 1.34}. kubectl 1.35 not supported during upgrade. Once all servers are 1.34, kubectl 1.35 becomes supported.
